## Security

- [ ] No credentials, secrets, install scripts, or remote README/runtime/image fetches.
- [ ] Unpublished plugin entries are labelled and the install control is unavailable.
- [ ] Any `.zdx` URL and SHA-256 describe a real, prebuilt, self-contained archive.
- [ ] Theme previews are local regular PNGs at 1200×800 / 390×844 with plain-text alt; no SVG, remote image, submitted CSS/code, placeholder or install link.
- [ ] A theme record is `source-preview` (not `built-in`) unless a maintainer curated it, and no theme package is implied.
